comment: The Vessel Studio catalog. Amoebius's VESSEL STUDIO page lists these; index.html shows the same studios. Add a studio here and in index.html. Optional accent: the card colour on the hub and the Unity home, a domain key from studio-domains.js (jade, ruby, gold, blue) or a #hex. Optional engineMode: an arcade mode (GameModes name) that PLAY IN ENGINE opens from the main menu in the Amoebius player, the game's own vessel; engineNote says what that run is. "shared": files every studio page loads beside it (studio-look.js = the default graphics, /vessel-studio D19); build_artifact.py publishes them. "mirror": the live mirror, a plain https copy of the same build_artifact.py output (OPEN LIVE IN BROWSER); a mirror of the one artifact in "web", never a second source. Cards (/vessel-studio D34): every surface shows the hub's studio cards. index.html draws them; the native homes (Amoebius's VESSEL STUDIO page, Unity's studio home) draw them from these fields, so they carry the hub's text exactly: "chip", "summary", "spec" (the rows under it), "preview" (a thumbnail of the hub's live canvas, baked by .claude/skills/vessel-studio/bake_previews.cjs), "tuner" (Unity has a TUNE IN UNITY page for it), and on the catalog "lede", "fleet", "fleetNote" and "cardActions": the card's buttons in order, the hosts they work on (web, amoebius, unity) and what a studio needs for one. parity_gate.py fails when these and the hub differ.
lede: Pick a vessel and its studio opens: fly it with gamepad, keys or your phone's thumbs, switch its play-style types and element levels, and read what every number does. The same pages open here, in Unity and Amoebius, and in your phone's browser.

cardActions.tip: The published build on the live mirror (GitHub Pages), in your browser.

studios.name: Squirrel
studios.kind: built vessel - studio round 2 (AI sim lab)
studios.summary: The racer, now with an AI sim lab: race AI Squirrels at Easy, Medium or Hard on the game's four Skim Race courses, or hand your hull to the AI and watch with a chase, follow or free camera. Six play-style types over its four element levels.
studios.engineNote: The game's own Squirrel in Skim Race, against the shipped AI (pick intensity and AI difficulty on the card).

studios.name: Stoat
studios.summary: The slinger. Squeeze a trigger to lay a black-white hole pair and sling round it. Five play styles, momentum carry, a four-level course ladder, an AI sim lab that races every style and scores it, and the round-15 field trajectory (a predicted path that boosts you when it loops back on itself). Editor layout with tabs and pop-out windows; touch sticks on a phone.
studios.engineNote: The game's own Stoat in the Slingshot race (the round-4 orbit sling the game ships today, not the studio's dipole sling).

fleetNote: No studio yet. Ask the studio agent below to start one; each needs the vessel's own numbers read from its assets first.
